id: \rWelcome. The President is currently away and not taking visitors.
en: \rWelcome. The President is currently away and not taking visitors.
it: \rBenvenuto. Il Presidente al momento è assente e non riceve visite.

id: \rYou do not have permission to access the building.
en: \rYou do not have permission to access the building.
it: \rNon hai il permesso di accedere all'edificio.

id: \bJames: We've done it. We have so many Poké Balls now we will be able to catch everything.
en: \bJames: We've done it. We have so many Poké Balls now we will be able to catch everything.
it: \bJames: Ce l'abbiamo fatta. Ora abbiamo così tante Poké Ball che potremo catturare qualunque cosa.

id: \rJessie: Just don't lose them all this time.
en: \rJessie: Just don't lose them all this time.
it: \rJessie: Basta che stavolta non le perdi tutte.

id: \bMeowth: Forget about that. The twerp is here. Let's beat their Pokémon up and get out of here.
en: \bMeowth: Forget about that. The twerp is here. Let's beat their Pokémon up and get out of here.
it: \bMeowth: Lasciate perdere. È arrivato il moccioso. Pestiamo i suoi Pokémon e filiamocela.
